code:
rows = int(input())
cols = int(input())
grid = [[0] * cols] * rows
grid[0][1] = 5
print(grid)
alt: The program builds a grid by repeating one row list, then changes one cell. Every row shows the change, because they are the same list object. A one-row grid has nothing to share.
